payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_report.py::test_unread_and_unanswered_blockers_rank_with_sustained_and_render_apart stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The cell is always plural, so one renders as `1 unread blockers`.' applied to saffron/report/index.py as an edit. The claim was '`QueueLine` carries `unread` and `unanswered` counts, both 0 by default. A line in any state of `_RANKED_BY_RISK`, with either count above 0, ranks at level 3 beside a sustained blocker and above an elevated line. Its row renders `1 unread blocker` and `2 unread blockers`, and `1 unanswered blocker` and `2 unanswered blockers`, each in its own cell. A count of 0 renders nothing. The witness drives each state of `_RANKED_BY_RISK`.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_the_fast_gates_name_their_tool_and_pass_on_a_clean_tree[format], and the criterion's witness did not fail.
